name: Skylight Roof Module
summary: A tileable 4 m square atrium skylight with sixteen pale aqua glass panes, satin steel framing, graphite seals and matching half-width boundary members.
description: A tileable 4 m square atrium skylight with sixteen pale aqua glass panes, satin steel framing, graphite seals and matching half-width boundary members.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and materials; no external assets, textures, fonts, brands or lettering.
origin: Floor centre at the roof frame underside; translate Y to the intended roof elevation.

tiling.edge_rule: Two clipped half members form one full shared member. Translate without scaling.
tiling.assembly_test: 3 x 3 actual-export grid; twelve matching seams; axis-aligned placement only.

material_notes: Three shared materials. Pale aqua glass is double-sided alpha BLEND 0.30; no refraction or transmission. Studio floor and lighting excluded from export.
accuracy_notes: Original visual roof module. Structural load, drainage, weatherproofing, building compliance, physical devices and complete-mall performance are not verified.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and materials. No external assets.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
